sourceIssues.printed: The raw f-Coleman map has pseudo-null cokernel in I_f⊗Λ_K, deg(π_•)I_f=ℤ_p, and multiplying this map by deg(π_•)H_p(f) is again claimed to give pseudo-null cokernel in Λ_K.
sourceIssues.correction: These claims require a corrected target lattice, raw-map normalization, or an explicit height-one cokernel term. With the stated raw target and degree identity, the normalized map has cokernel length v_p(H_p(f)) at (p). Retain the reciprocity image identity and the rationalized map comparison; do not assert the integral pseudo-null claim when H_p(f) is a nonunit.
sourceIssues.reason: Localize at the height-one prime (p). The raw map becomes an isomorphism, and degree multiplication identifies I_f with ℤ_p. Subsequent multiplication by H_p(f) has nonzero cokernel when α_p²≡1 mod p. The permitted ordinary case a_p≡−1 mod p gives α_p≡−1, so the local character exclusion does not force H_p(f) to be a unit. The inconsistency concerns these simultaneous normalization assertions, not a disproof of the main-conjecture endpoint.

sourceIssues.locator: Author addendum of 24 July 2022, p.1, Lemma 0.2 and its proof; PDF visually checked
sourceIssues.printed: The three projection hypotheses are claimed to allow the first m−1 coordinate factors to be identified inside N and to imply that N intersected with that coordinate hyperplane satisfies the same hypotheses with m reduced by one.
sourceIssues.correction: Neither inference follows from the stated projection hypotheses. Establish the needed arithmetic/geometric induction by an additional valid argument, or verify the published independent second proof of Corollary 3.19. An identification of the entire coordinate hyperplane inside N would itself force the full-rank conclusion and is not furnished by its surjective projection.
sourceIssues.reason: Take a field A, m=3 and N={(x,y,z):x+y+z=0}. N is free, all coordinate-pair projections and the first-two-coordinate projection are onto, and N≠A³. Its intersection with A²×0 is {(x,−x,0)}, whose projection to A² is not onto. Thus the asserted m=2 projection condition fails. The alleged containment A²×0⊂N also fails.
